note: *Deus de todos* keeps *ómnium* open; MS1932 and the Diurnal say *de todas as coisas*, the LH *do universo*, the Lectionary *do mundo inteiro*: all decide for things.
*quem escapa*: the blind reader heard *quem se salva* as a curse on the saved. The v2 Latinist asks *se salva* back (the Latin keeps *salvári*); the v1 Latinist had passed it.
*E os herdareis*: the blind reader heard no referent for *os* and a death in *herdar*. Kept as 81:8; *E os tereis por herança* and the Lectionary's *dai-lhes a herança* are options.
*sobre o qual foi invocado o vosso nome* keeps the Hebraism; the blind reader heard 'the people who called on your name'. The Lectionary's *que é chamado pelo vosso nome* the option.
